$schema: LLM pricing comparison data — Tab 1 (Pricing Comparison) and Tab 2 (Cost Calculator)
notes: Prices pulled directly from each provider's official pricing/docs pages, all six providers re-verified live on 2026-10-14 (x.ai/api itself returned 403, so xAI was checked via docs.x.ai). Each provider is represented by its current-generation model in each tier; where a newer model replaced an older one that is still sold (e.g. Claude Opus 5, GPT-5.6 Sol/Luna, Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview, Mistral Large 3), the replacement is noted in the new entry and the older model's history stays on the Pricing History tab. Several current rates are time-limited — Gemini 4 Argon doubles on 2026-12-01, Gemini 3.8 Flash doubles on 2027-01-01, Mistral Large 4 is on an open-ended sale price — see each model's notes. LLM pricing changes frequently — re-check the source URLs periodically rather than treating this as permanent. All providers below price in tokens; none required credit/compute-unit normalization at the time of writing.

models.notes: Launched 2026-09-03, priced ~2.5x GPT-5.6 Sol. openai.com/api/pricing/ was unreachable while compiling this entry (403), so figures are cross-checked across OpenAI's own launch post (openai.com/index/gpt-6-astra/) and multiple third-party trackers (Yotta Labs, Layer3 Labs, AiCybr) that agree on these numbers. Rate shown is for prompts <=272,000 tokens; above that threshold pricing rises to $20 input / $75 output / $2 cached (2x input & cache, 1.5x output). Cache writes cost extra at $12.50/MTok. Fast mode (up to 2x speed) is 2x standard rates; Batch/Flex processing is 50% of standard.

Launched 2026-09-29 (OpenAI DevDay), succeeding GPT-6 Sol (2026-09-22, $2/$10/$0.20) and GPT-5.6 Sol as the Sol-line frontier option; OpenAI positions it as 'near-Astra performance' for complex coding, computer use and professional work. GPT-5.6 Sol is still sold at its $4/$20 promotional rate (through at least 2026-11-21), now pricier than this newer model. Rate shown is for prompts <=272,000 tokens; above that it rises to $4 input / $15 output / $0.20 cached. Cache writes cost $2.50/MTok. Context window 1.05M (922K max input, 128K max output) per developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6.1-sol; prices per developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-10-14).

No GPT-6-generation Terra exists yet, so this remains OpenAI's mid-range entry — though note GPT-6.1 Sol now matches it on input and undercuts it on output and cached input. Context window 1.05M (922K max input, 128K max output) per developers.openai.com/api/docs/models (corrected from the earlier 1M figure); prices re-verified on developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing 2026-10-14.

Launched 2026-09-22, replacing GPT-5.6 Luna ($0.20/$1.20, still sold) at roughly half the price; also OpenAI's named replacement for GPT-4o/4o mini/4.1/4.1 mini (shutdown 2027-01-14) and gpt-5.4-nano (shutdown 2027-04-01). Rate shown is for prompts <=272,000 tokens; above that input and cached double and output rises 1.5x. Context window 1.05M (922K max input, 128K max output) per developers.openai.com/api/docs/models/gpt-6-luna; prices per developers.openai.com/api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-10-14).

Full 1M token context included at standard pricing. Cached input shown is the cache-read (hit) rate — unusually 0.025x base input for this model/Mythos 5.1 (vs. 0.1x for other Claude models). Writing to cache costs extra: 1.25x base input for a 5-min TTL cache ($12.50/MTok) or 2x for a 1-hour TTL ($20/MTok).

Launched 2026-09-22, replacing Claude Opus 5 ($5/$25/$0.50 — now 'Legacy', still available, retirement not before 2027-07-24) at 20% lower input/output and 60% lower cache reads. Anthropic recommends Opus 5.5 for most workloads and Fable 5.1 for the most demanding ones. Cached input shown is the cache-read rate (0.05x base input). Cache writes: $5/MTok (5-min TTL) or $8/MTok (1-hour TTL). Fast mode is $8/$40. 128K max output. Per platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing and release notes (checked 2026-10-14).

Launched 2026-09-28 at the same list price as Claude Sonnet 5 (now 'Legacy'); cache reads cut from $0.20 to $0.10/MTok on 2026-10-07. Cache writes: $2.50/MTok (5-min TTL) or $4/MTok (1-hour TTL). 128K max output. Per platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (checked 2026-10-14).

Launched 2026-10-07, replacing Claude Haiku 4.5 ($1/$5, now 'Legacy'). Prompt-length-tiered pricing, set per request: rates shown are for prompts <=100K input tokens (cached tokens count toward the threshold); above 100K the whole request is billed at $0.50 input / $2.50 output / $0.05 cached. 128K max output. Per platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/pricing (checked 2026-10-14).

Google's new flagship reasoning model, GA 2026-10-13. Launch rate shown applies through 2026-11-30; from 2026-12-01 it doubles to $4.00 input / $20.00 output / $0.20 cached. No <=200K / >200K split; output price includes thinking tokens. Implicit caching only (no explicit caching). Batch/Flex 50% off; Priority 1.8x. Context window 1,048,576 tokens shared between input and output, per ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/models/gemini-4-argon. Supersedes Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview ($2/$12, still listed, no deprecation notice) as Google's frontier entry. Per ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing (checked 2026-10-14).

Rate shown applies through Dec 31, 2026; Google's pricing page schedules a rise to $1.50 input / $7.50 output / $0.15 cached from Jan 1, 2027 (Batch/Flex/Priority double too). Re-verified 2026-10-14. Batch API gets 50% off. 64k max output tokens. Cached-content storage is billed separately at $0.50 per million tokens per hour (rising to $1.00 in 2027).

Batch API gets 50% off (cached input drops to $0.02/M in Batch). 64k max output tokens. Context/prompt caching is now offered for this model in the Standard tier at $0.03/M cached input — reversing the prior finding that it wasn't available; cached-content storage billed separately at $1.00 per million tokens per hour. Re-verified directly on ai.google.dev/gemini-api/docs/pricing on 2026-09-23.

Public Preview (not GA), launched 2026-10-06. Rates shown are the current sale price listed on docs.mistral.ai/inference/pricing and the model page; no end date is given. List price is $1.36 input / $4.18 output / $0.14 cached (the only price printed in the launch post, mistral.ai/news/mistral-large-4). Context window 1M per docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-large-4-0 (some third-party trackers say 512K). Supersedes Mistral Large 3 ($0.50/$1.50, still listed, not deprecated) as the frontier entry; open weights promised for end of October 2026.

Priced higher than both Large 3 and Large 4 on this provider's page — not a typo in this file; re-verified 2026-10-14. Confirmed still the case via Wayback Machine snapshots of mistral.ai's pricing pages through 2026-09-21, with no evidence of change since. Context window from OpenRouter's Mistral Medium 3.5 listing (not shown on the pricing page itself). Cached input is a 90% discount off base input, consistent across the Mistral lineup.
Context window from docs.mistral.ai/models/mistral-small-4-0-26-03 (not shown on the pricing page itself). Cached input is a 90% discount off base input, consistent across the Mistral lineup.
Off-peak rates shown. Peak (01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC, Mon-Fri) doubles all rates to $1.32 input / $3.96 output / $0.044 cached.

Renamed from 'DeepSeek-V4-Flash' on 2026-09-10, per DeepSeek's own docs — the old model ID was retired and requests are now served by this one under a new 'deepseek-flash' API name, resolving a naming discrepancy flagged in an earlier version of this dataset. Off-peak rates shown. Peak (01:00-04:00 & 06:00-10:00 UTC, Mon-Fri) doubles all rates to $0.30 input / $1.20 output / $0.006 cached.

Launched 2026-09-21, replacing Grok 4.6 at the identical list price (xAI's own announcement highlighted this as unchanged pricing despite a larger base model). Cached input shown is the short-context cache rate (from docs.x.ai/developers/pricing, not the main x.ai/api marketing page). Long-context requests (200K+ prompt tokens, per docs.x.ai/docs/models, re-checked 2026-10-14) use higher rates for every token in the request: $4.00 input / $1.00 cached / $12.00 output.
